newsitem.title: USA: U.S. bulk millfeeds - Strong demand lifts prices.
newsitem.headline: U.S. bulk millfeeds - Strong demand lifts prices.

text.p: Strong demand by feed mixers lifted millfeed prices in many areas with most of the demand for prompt shipment, dealers said.

North Texas millfeed traded up $4 at $118 per ton for prompt shipment, Minneapolis millfeed traded up $5 at $88 , also for prompt shipment. The benchmark Kansas City rail market was bid unchanged at $96 but offers rose $2 to $101.

Declining pasture conditions and cool weather boosted feed demand in many areas. Also, once prices firmed early this week, buying increased as feed mixers were anxious to accumulate inventory before prices increased further.
"There are a lot of people looking for nearby stuff and there isn't any," said a Texas dealer.
He said bids and offers were scarce beyond December.
Portland sources said prices were steady from Tuesday but strong demand was coming from the dairy industry in northern California and Oregon.
Light demand was reported near Buffalo where feedmixers have ample supplies and prices has a steady to weak tone, dealers there said.
